name: Creepy Kids Zone
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap the ghost to reveal a kite.
Tap the red puddle to reveal jam.
Tap the sandbox to uncover a doll.
Tap the bush to reveal faulty wiring.
Tap the doll and remove its batteries.
Tap the backpack to stop the ringtone.
Tap the swing to reveal a squirrel.
Tap the lawnmower to reveal a tomato.
